metadata.description: AI film and image contest entries, from rules to submission, with a lessons table learned from real failed and fixed entries.

plugins.name: contest-film-pipeline
plugins.description: Contest AI film/image pipeline: rules check, dialogue-first script with a clear opening, character and location sheets, three.js previz, 3-second prompt rows, unlimited-slot generation ledger, upscale/grade/captions, 1-second scene sheet, short-shot and length checks, first-time-viewer review, submission-form traps and publishing rules. 72 lessons from real entries.
